frozen: 2026-10-15, before any IG history pull and before the ig function existed in production
by: the 2026-10-15 verification (docs/agents/reviews/2026-10-15-ig-verification.md); spec SPEC-for-verification.md hard rule 6
rule: Nothing below changes after an IG answer is read. A change is a new proposal to Davies, recorded as such, and every result under the old value is still reported.
time_zone: UK wall clock (Europe/London: BST from 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday of March to 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday of October)

g2.weekend_fridays: anchor_friday and the 50 Fridays before it, one week apart: 2026-10-09 back to 2025-10-24
g2.pad_reason: IG's /prices v3 documents from/to as yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss without a zone; the request is padded and every bar is placed by snapshotTimeUTC

budget_upper_bound_points.note: one point an hour over each padded span; IG returns no bar for a closed hour, so the expected cost is far lower
budget_upper_bound_points.fxw_per_weekend: 79 (78 or 80 when the clocks change inside the window)
budget_upper_bound_points.order: week 1 on the spread-bet account: probe, fxw, esg. wknd on the CFD account's own allowance (IG states the allowance per API key and account), over two weeks if the reserve binds.

s1a.pair: AUD/USD, the spread-bet account's rolling (DFB) epic chosen by facts; the CFD epic as a second reading, never pooled
s1a.friday_close_uk: the close in the epic's G1 openingHours when stated; otherwise 22:00 UK, and the row says which
s1a.sunday_open_uk: the open in the epic's G1 openingHours when stated; otherwise the first bar after the Friday close, and the row says which
s1a.friday_reference_mid: (bid_close + ask_close) / 2 of the last HOUR bar starting before the Friday close with both sides present
s1a.first_tradable_bar: the first HOUR bar starting at or after the Sunday open with both bid_open and ask_open present and ask_open > bid_open
s1a.gap: ln(first tradable bar's open mid / Friday reference mid)
s1a.opening_spread_bps: 1e4 * (ask_open - bid_open) / open mid, on the first tradable bar
s1a.entry: against the gap at the first tradable bar's executable open: a fall buys at ask_open, a rise sells at bid_open
s1a.exit_close_only: the first bar whose exit-side close (bid_close for a long, ask_close for a short) reaches the target, at that close; otherwise the exit-side close of the last bar starting within 24 h of the entry bar
s1a.exit_range_crossing: the first bar whose exit-side range (bid_high for a long, ask_low for a short) reaches the target, at the target; otherwise as close-only
s1a.funding_line_bps: G1's documented overnight funding for the product when stated; otherwise 2 bps, labelled an assumption; reported apart from the price P&L
s1a.headline: neither scoring is a fill claim; both are printed
s1a.fxcm_pairing: the committed FXCM weekend table (statarb_search2/inputs/fx/fxcm_AUDUSD_weekends.csv.gz) by the weekend's Friday UTC date; each feed's Friday-last and Sunday-first timestamps printed, and the difference in minutes
s1a.yahoo_pairing: none: the repository holds no Yahoo hourly AUD/USD (ig_research/inputs/yahoo_1h has ES=F only); reported as not available

transfer_bar.unexplained_gap: a weekend with no Friday reference bar, no first tradable bar, or a missing HOUR bar between the first tradable bar and Monday 22:00 UK

s1a.complete_weekend: a Friday reference bar and a first tradable bar both present
s1a.quantiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default), p25/p50/p75

g3.fxw_rule: STATARB-2 E0: fade a Sunday-open FXCM gap with |g| >= 20 bps, target Friday's mid, force close at +24 h (mid_24h)
g3.entry_cost: half the assumed opening spread at entry, against the trade

bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of the resampled means
